## Testing

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes (including on a
      host without `adb` installed)
- [ ] Live validation run on real hardware, if the change touches
      the provisioning flow, exploit invocation, or on-device
      components — describe it here (provision + two recovery
      reboots + final state), or state why it is exempt
      (docs/tests only)

## Docs

- [ ] README.md / FORK.md / CHANGELOG.md updated if behavior,
      flags, or supported targets changed
- [ ] No device-specific data (LAN addresses, serials, logs) in the
      change

## Attribution

- [ ] New files carry the SPDX header used by neighboring files
- [ ] If AI tools materially helped with this change, that is stated
      here, and I have reviewed and tested the result myself
